text:
tayla-sales: Quick sync  SummitCare asked for a 5-week POC. They want recommended reserved GPU commit, autoscale policy template, burst credit guidance, and what we can include regarding VPC peering & SOC2. Workload: multi-tenant chat + embeddings. Steady ~210 rps, short spikes to ~1.15k for 8-12 minutes. Avg request ~130 tokens. They also asked if we can support a model pin and quant level in the SOW. Any immediate issues?

sophie-solutions: Great lead. Two clarifying Qs: is traffic single-region and do spikes correlate with specific internal cron jobs? Also need expected concurrent sessions to size KV warmup.

tayla-sales: Traffic is mostly US-East; concurrency ~1.9k concurrent sessions at peak. Spikes tied to batch digest jobs that trigger user notifications.

omar-sre: For that profile and q4 quant, our observed throughput ~330 rps/GPU. For steady 210 rps a minimal config is 2 reserved GPUs, but to meet SLA and avoid noisy neighbor issues I recommend 5 reserved GPUs with autoscale to 15 for burst headroom. Spread reserved pool across AZs (min 2 per AZ). Preheat and KV warmup are essential.

kevin-runtime: Agree. We should lock model+quant in the SOW (example: redwood-clarity-1.1 + q4_0). Sample autoscale we use for presales: 
```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: "1"
  reserved_replicas: "5"
  max_replicas: "15"
  target_rps_per_gpu: "330"
  scale_window: "60s"
  preheat_window: "5m"
  cooldown: "90s"
  az_spread: "true"
  circuit_breaker:
    queue_depth: ">450"
    action: "route_noncritical_to_smaller_model"
```

sophie-solutions: For the POC offer: recommend 5 reserved GPUs + 10 burstable, capped burst credits (e.g., 8k burst-minutes), and a mandatory 72hr smoke run mid-POC against the customers golden prompt set. We'll provide runbook and load scripts.

diego-pricing: Pricing notes: 5 reserved GPUs baseline, burst beyond credits billed at on-demand. For the capped pool I can add a single SKU. If customer requires model pin + quant guarantee, we should reflect that in the SOW and price accordingly (predictability premium). Need estimated burst minutes per month to finalize numbers.

mira-security: SOC2 artifacts are fine to share. For VPC peering we need their CIDRs and an NDA for log sharing. Customer-managed KMS in POC is possible but needs dedicated setup and additional lead time; treat as enterprise add-on. We'll provide sanitized audit samples for the POC if they need examples.

tayla-sales: Legal asked whether we can commit to 50p gen latency <100ms for chat during steady-state. Realistic?

kevin-runtime: Not for a full-size chat model at this token size. Recommend offering: embeddings/search 50p <100ms and chat 50p <250ms as the standard POC targets. If they insist on 100ms chat 50p, propose a premium SLA that includes a distilled model and higher reserved commit. Also include fallback rules in the SOW so we can route to smaller model variants if needed.

omar-sre: Ops checklist to add in the proposal/runbook:
- CIDR/IP allowlist for VPC peering
- planned preheat schedule (daily morning preheat + warmup before known digests)
- smoke test steps + golden prompt set for acceptance
- alerting (queue-depth, GPU saturation, 95p latency) + pager rules
- fallback policy (auto-degrade to smaller model)

sophie-solutions: Ill draft the POC runbook and the load generator config. We should also request a short sample of typical user prompts to build the golden set.

diego-pricing: Ill prepare two price scenarios: standard POC and SLA-upgrade with predictability premium and extra reserved GPUs.

smoke-bot: queued_presales_smoke: summitcare_poc_2026-10-12, ETA 22m.

tayla-sales: Next steps: 1) Ill ask customer for CIDRs + sample prompts + burst cadence, 2) diego will post pricing lines (std + premium), 3) mira will attach SOC2 bundle and CMK timeline note, 4) sophie + omar will stage sandbox pool and run smoke. Tagging @sophie-solutions @omar-sre @diego-pricing @mira-security.

mira-security: Ill also attach a short controls checklist they can return (CIDRs, retention, CMK intent).

tayla-sales: Thanks team  will update SummitCare and loop back once we have the items. :thumbsup:
